standingCard.title: Research grant
standingCard.question: Approve this research grant?
standingCard.body_md:
## Let this room look things up in OpenAlex?

OpenAlex is a public index of scholarly papers. A grant lets the room send short search strings there. It covers fetching only; filing still asks each time.

- Provider: openalex; fallback: none (if it is down, the run says so and stops)
- What is searched: OpenAlex titles, abstracts and metadata; nothing else leaves the room
- Search shapes allowed (by template id): whitespace-gap/v1: ws.exact, ws.synonym_cover, ws.prior_attempts, ws.absence_reason; concept-evidence/v1: ce.exact, ce.counter, ce.prior_success, ce.alternative, ce.pair
- Caps per run: 3 searches, 5 results per search
- Throttle: 1 room-started run per hour
- Expires: 2026-11-01 (30 days from today)
- Room scope: only this room (golden-room-366:5e6517f5cdfd); it does not carry to any other room
- Policy version: drp363-grant/1
- Revoke: tell Larry "revoke the research grant" at any time; the next search stops

New terms that would leave the room the first time (approving covers these):
- alpha

A grant never files anything. Anything worth keeping comes back as its own yes or no.

runCard.title: See every search before it leaves, then approve this run once.
runCard.question: Send these 3 searches to OpenAlex for this run?
runCard.body_md:
These 3 searches will leave this machine for this research run. Nothing is sent until you approve.

OpenAlex is a public index of scholarly papers. Each search goes there exactly as written, once, for this run only. Nothing else leaves the room, and nothing is filed.

No search strings could be listed, so nothing will be sent.

- Caps for this run: 3 searches, 5 results each
- Room scope: only this room
- Revoke: tell Larry to revoke the search approval at any time; the next search stops

Approving never files anything. Anything worth keeping comes back as its own yes or no.
